description: This file defines the IconExtractorPluginManager class, which manages icon extractor plugins within Drupal's theme system. It includes methods for retrieving and creating plugin forms for icon extractors, and manages plugin configurations and cache.

classes.name: IconExtractorPluginManager
classes.description: A plugin manager class for handling icon extractor plugins in Drupal, providing methods to retrieve and manage icon extractor forms and configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin manager with namespaces, cache backend, module handler, and plugin form factory.

methods.name: getExtractorForms
methods.description: Returns an array of extractor forms indexed by extractor id, based on provided icon pack configurations.

methods.name: getExtractorForm
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extractor form for a given icon pack configuration.

methods.name: getPluginForm
methods.description: Creates and returns the plugin form for a given icon extractor, using the plugin form factory if the extractor supports forms.
